name: Herceg Novi in a day
description_md:
Herceg Novi in a day is a waymarked hiking route located in ME. The trail covers a distance of 10.7 km and requires about 6.9 hours of walking time based on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

This route provides a path for those interested in a waymarked experience. It is designed to be completed within a single day.
